newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France renews chairman's mandate.
newsitem.headline: Air France renews chairman's mandate.

text.p: The board of state-owned Air France renewed the mandate of Chairman Christian Blanc for five years, an airline spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
She said mandates were renewed for nine other directors and Lacharriere chairman Marck Ladreit joined the board.
It also approved the 1995/96 results showing a 2.87 billion franc loss after a 2.0 billion restructuring charge.

Blanc replaced chairman Bernard Attali, who stepped down in November 1993 after ground crew strikes. Blanc has embarked on an ambitious restructuring, which entails the merger of Air France's European operations with its domestic arm Air Inter.
